 <div class="hotel-landing__info">

 <h1 class="hotel-landing__name">Villa Rasa</h1>
 <div class="hotel-landing__address">
 <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/location_map_icon.svg" alt="location">
 <span>Av. José Bento Ribeiro Dantas, 299 , Armacao De Buzios 28950-000</span>
 <a class="hotel-landing__map-link location_maps" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#hotel_map">
 See on Map </a>
 </div>
 <div class="hotel-landing__description">
 Enjoy the pleasure of being in Búzios! Villa Rasa is located in Praia Rasa, an exclusive area of the resort, facing the sea. 
The idea here is to stay on a practically private beach with complete facilities, perfect for a trip that values comfort and well-being. 
The inn is made up of two ‘villas’: Villa da Praia and Villa do Jardim. In Villa da Praia (on the sea side), there are 20 apartments and suites and most of the inn’s common areas: reception, restaurant, swimming pool, steam room, massage room and a playroom. Across the street, there is Villa do Jardim, with 15 more standard apartments, a delightful swimming pool integrated with the sauna, an event hall and parking with limited spaces (according to availability at the time of check in).
 </div>
 </div>
